answer: Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. The gale of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, re-queued for a second panel, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Work waits on the ridge until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the ferrous of the next round.
